title: Differentiation of Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells
author: Elena Coccia
materials: After day 10, switch to post-patterning maturation media.

steps.title: Thaw and Prepare hiPSCs
steps.instruction: Thaw a vial of hiPSCs, resuspend in 10 mL culture medium, centrifuge at 160 g for 3 minutes, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL Accutase, incubate at 37 °C for 5 minutes, neutralize with 10 mL culture medium, centrifuge again at 160 g for 3 minutes, resuspend in 5 mL culture medium, and plate on Geltrex‑coated plates at 400,000 cells / cm².

substeps.instruction: Thaw hiPSC vial and add 10 mL culture medium.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL Accutase; incubate 37 °C, 5 min.
Centrifuge again at 160 g for 3 min.
Plate on Geltrex‑coated plates at 400,000 cells / cm².

steps.title: Add ROCK inhibitor
steps.instruction: Add Y‑27632 to the culture medium to a final concentration of 10 µM and incubate the cells for 24 hours.

steps.title: Prepare differentiation base media
steps.instruction: Combine 500 mL Neurobasal medium, 5 mL Glutamax, 5 mL B27 supplement, and 5 mL N2 supplement to make the base differentiation media.

steps.title: Add small‑molecule supplements
steps.instruction: Supplement the base media with 250 nM LDN193189, 10 µM SB431542, 1 µM SAG, and CHIR at the following concentrations: 0.7 µM for days 0‑3, 7.5 µM for days 4‑9, and 3 µM for days 10‑11.

steps.title: Change differentiation media
steps.instruction: Replace the culture medium every 2 days, using the appropriate CHIR concentration for the current day as specified.

steps.title: Prepare maturation media
steps.instruction: To the base media add 20 ng/mL GDNF, 20 ng/mL BDNF, 0.2 mM ascorbic acid, 0.1 mM dibutyryl cAMP, and 1 ng/mL TGF‑β3.

steps.title: Switch to maturation media
steps.instruction: On day 10 replace the differentiation media with the maturation media and continue feeding every 2 days for 4 weeks.
